name: stm32f103
description: ST STM32F103x8/xB (Cortex-M3 72 MHz, 64/128 KB flash, 20 KB SRAM, USB FS device, bxCAN, 2 ADC, 3 USART, 2 SPI, 2 I2C, TIM1-4, RTC): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeF1 HAL/LL, Renode stm32f103 platform

toolchain.notes: Link with a STM32F103RBTx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32f103xb.s from a Cube example (Projects/STM32F103RB-Nucleo/Templates). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree; CubeIDE board projects build with `embeddyn mechatronics import`.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_f103rb.repl (LD2 PA5 = led2, B1 PC13 = sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton, active low, VCP usart2) and platforms/boards/st/blue_pill_stm32f103.repl (LED PC13). The RCC clock tree (HSI/HSE/PLL, HPRE, PPRE1/PPRE2, ADCPRE, RTCSEL) drives SysTick, the timers and the RTC. GPIO uses the F1 CRL/CRH model with AFIO EXTICR and remaps; bit-band aliases at 0x22000000/0x42000000. DMA1 requests are wired to their fixed channels (RM0008 table 78). ADC1/2: 'adc1 SetVoltage microvolts channel', temperature sensor channel 16 ('adc1 Temperature 30'), VREFINT 17; TIM1/2/3/4 TRGO reach the ADC trigger inputs. Flash: page erase/program/mass erase with FPEC keys. RTC: 32-bit counter with prescaler, alarm (EXTI 17). USB FS device: packet memory at 0x40006000 (16-bit words on a 32-bit stride). Pins: add 'pins: Miscellaneous.PinRecorder @ gpioPortA 0' and connections such as 'gpioPortA:' / '    5 -> led2@0 | pins@5' (a .repl file), then 'sysbus.gpioPortA.pins Edges 5'. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeF1 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_f103.txt in the Renode tree)
